title: Manager - Trainer
description:
****Position Title****
 Manager \- Trainer
   

  

****Purpose of Role****
 To build and run TEPCO's site training capability — developing and executing the training modules for mechanized, assembly\-line transmission construction with core purpose of optimizing man days in all the phases of construction, and, most importantly,
 **driving their adoption on the ground** 
 so that gangs work to the new method with confidence, consistency and pace.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
**Training design \& Content development**
* Conduct change management workshops with Projects, Gang Leaders \& all workers.
* Develop and maintain training modules for the assembly\-line methodology and mechanized construction techniques (e.g. DAGP erection, drone\-based stringing), covering each sub\-gang role across foundation, erection and stringing.
* Build simple, field\-usable
* Training materials
* SOPs,
* Visual work instructions
* job aids
* Toolbox\-talk content
* Videos and Demonstrations
* Equipment Operating Guides
* Quick Reference Cards
* Translate technical procedures into practical site level instructions suitable for workforce with varying literacy and experience levels.


**Adoption on site — the core of the role**
* Run structured on\-site induction and hands\-on training at mobilization , and refresher training at the start of each project.
* Work alongside gangs at the work\-front to embed the assembly\-line method, coach on cycle\-time discipline, and troubleshoot resistance or bottlenecks as they arise.
* Partner with the Project Manager, Mechanization leads and vertical teams to sequence training with the execution plan, so training enables the schedule rather than interrupting it.
* Identify and develop experienced workers as peer trainers, creating a self\-sustaining training capability at site.
* Identify high potential workers and prepare succession plans for critical gang and equipment operator positions.
* Enhancing schedule adherence through the effective adoption of mechanized construction methodologies.


**Measurement and improvement**
* Track training coverage, competency levels, and the link between training and on\-ground productivity (progress toward the man\-days/km target).
* Create a competency grading system (Beginner, skilled , advanced, export) to support workforce planning.
* Feed field observations back into module design, continuously improving both the method and the training.
* Establish the foundations of a repeatable, scalable training programme that can be rolled out to future TEPCO sites and, in time, a team.
* Create a train the trainer program to build scalable internal capabilities across all our projects.
* Monitor cycle times and identify operational inefficiencies impacting productivity.
* Conduct RCA of productivity analysis attributable to manpower skill gaps and implement corrective action/developmental plans


**Safety plus Quality Training \& Compliance**
* Ensuring all compliance w.r.t. QHSE pre\-requisites viz. required TPI of all machines, running essential checks on SOP requirements, Training w.r.t. safety aspects.
* Ensure all workers are trained and certified for critical construction activities before deployment.
* Conduct regular safety awareness sessions and practical demonstrations.
* Track effectiveness of safety training through reduction in unsafe acts, near misses, and incidents.
* Develop quality\-focused skill assessments and certification standards for critical activities.


****Position Demands****
 Frequent Travel to Project Sites
   

  

****Competencies****
 Behavioural \- Achievement Orientation
   

  

 Behavioural \- Altrocentric Leadership
   

  

 Behavioural \- Initiative
   

  

 Behavioural \- Innovative Thinking
   

  

 Functional \- Financial
   

  

 Functional \- Operational
   

  

 Functional \- People
   

  

 Functional \- Strategic
